work_unit.title: 对账交付记录并稳定仓库验证基线
work_unit.goal: 只依据 T001 的可验证事实修复交付记录断链与状态漂移，并证明当前 HEAD 的全量 Vitest 基线是否可重复。

codebase_context.existing_pattern: Delivery records are append-only where possible; reconstructed receipts must explicitly say they are retrospective and must cite existing evidence, timeline, Git, and provider facts.
codebase_context.known_test_risk: Historical full runs reported heartbeat stale-queue/concurrency failures that passed in isolation. T002-A001 additionally proved that run-vitest-stable leaks each invocation root; 251 stale pcvt roots consumed 11.8 GiB and caused ENOSPC, database shutdown, and 112 cascading suite failures.
forbidden_changes: Do not invent a review, acceptance, screenshot, runtime fact, or command result.
Do not promote any historical target to accepted without explicit Outcome Owner acceptance.
Do not rewrite or delete existing timeline events.
Do not mutate the runtime database or historical Git commits.
Do not change heartbeat product code unless the focused RED case is reproducible and directly identifies a product race.
Test-harness changes must be limited to guaranteed cleanup of the per-invocation root and a regression test; no test timeout or assertion may be relaxed.

execution_constraints.ownership: Existing G1/G2 records are user-owned historical artifacts. Preserve their events and decisions; add provenance or corrected current fields only.

tdd_plan.red: Run the focused heartbeat stale-queue invalidation test repeatedly before any product source edit. Separately reproduce the run-vitest-stable per-invocation temp-root leak with a fake pnpm regression test.
tdd_plan.green: If RED proves a product defect, apply the smallest lifecycle fix and rerun focused/repeated tests. If no product RED, make no product-code change. Make the test harness delete each invocation root after the child exits without weakening tests.
tdd_plan.refactor: No refactor unless the focused test remains green after the minimum fix.

commands: for file in .verrail/targets/{g1-*,g2-*}/timeline.jsonl; do jq -e . "$file" >/dev/null || exit 1; done
validation_loop.failure_handling: Classify full-suite failures by reproducibility and changed-path ownership. The first full run failed after ENOSPC terminated the embedded PostgreSQL test environment; clean only generated pcvt roots, rerun the regression test, then rerun the relevant full-suite lanes without weakening assertions. The isolated workspace rerun proved that the OpenCode remote test copied the operator's 554 MiB XDG config into its fixture and deterministically exceeded five seconds; isolate XDG_CONFIG_HOME to an empty per-test directory rather than extending the timeout.

checks: No historical event or human decision was rewritten
Every reconstructed receipt is labeled retrospective
Status scope distinguishes delivery slice from runtime Target
No product code changed without reproducible RED
Full-suite disposition is supported by actual output

stop_conditions: A proposed reconciliation would fabricate or replace a human review or acceptance.
The current full-suite failure cannot be reproduced or attributed within the retry budget.
A required change expands beyond the reconciled test-harness temp-root leak or heartbeat race boundary.
Another change modifies an allowed historical record during execution.
